required_minor_revisions.title: Specify the exact output boundary for the V1 direction/amplitude identity
required_minor_revisions.finding: The text says actual BF16 prediction but defines e=G*(Y-Y_Q1), c=G*(Y_stable-Y_Q1). This does not uniquely identify whether Y values are pre-gate or already gated, and multiplying pre-gate differences in higher precision need not equal the difference after the actual final BF16 gate/cast.
required_minor_revisions.why_it_matters: The quadratic identity is exact for whichever observed outputs are defined, but a mathematical pre-gate/gate diagnostic must not be labelled exact reconstruction of the actual BF16 replay risk. Double-gating already-gated outputs would be a different loss.
required_minor_revisions.minimal_fix: Define primary z_m as the same-input actual consumer's gate/cast-completed FFN contribution at the observed boundary, not an unobserved full residual state. Set e=z_dense-z_Q1 and c=z_stable-z_Q1, reduced in F64. Keep G times pre-gate differences as a separately labelled mathematical diagnostic. State that DeltaR(eta) is exact for linear interpolation of those observed outputs, while changing/quantizing parameters requires an actual BF16 path check.
required_minor_revisions.author_response_before_edit: Author explicitly accepted this definition in a message; it was not yet in the reviewed bytes.

required_minor_revisions.title: Do not reinterpret the frozen epsilon_num as a relative tolerance
required_minor_revisions.finding: The living R1b paragraph still calls epsilon_num a relative numerical tolerance. The frozen R1 runner actually evaluates ridge_mse < q1_mse - epsilon_num, using an absolute MSE difference.
required_minor_revisions.minimal_fix: Preserve the frozen trigger's actual absolute-MSE meaning. Explain the ICC high4 absolute-versus-relative aggregation issue without retroactively assigning the old threshold a new unit. No rerun or frozen-report modification is needed.
required_minor_revisions.scope_impact: This is a reporting correction. It does not change the current route or require another numerical experiment.

required_minor_revisions.title: Distinguish the planned two-solvers/two-lambdas reporting from the actual scored arms
required_minor_revisions.finding: The historical-rule paragraph says both lambdas and both solvers are fully reported. Both original-FP32 lambdas were solved and have diagnostic metadata, but only original main, stable main and stable robust were scored on CAL/DEV; original robust was not a full fourth scored arm.
required_minor_revisions.minimal_fix: If retaining the historical planned rule, add a short actual-coverage note. Do not silently describe the evidence as a complete 2x2 scored table or schedule a rerun solely to fill it.
required_minor_revisions.scope_impact: The stable-main/stable-robust negative result remains supported.

nonblocking_clarifications.title: Name the aggregation for the native-h intervention ratios
nonblocking_clarifications.detail: The stated 1.2776 and 1.2691 are correct ratios of source-equal MSEs. The corresponding means of per-source ratios are 1.2823419715971438 and 1.2773988834853394. Add 'ratio of source-equal MSEs' when citing the former so the reader does not mistake them for the current V4 mean-relative primary.

nonblocking_clarifications.title: Keep cross-weight targets and anchors tied to the evaluated W in the concrete BW/BWS scope
nonblocking_clarifications.detail: The design's separate native FFN replays and same-W baselines support this already. In implementation every cell needs F_W(U_s), F_W(U_t), its own legal anchor quantities and common G_ref; do not reuse the D-capture's W_D Y as the target for W_O. This is an execution-contract reminder, not a new arm or a design blocker.

independently_verified.result: All six entries' stable main/robust relative risks, original-minus-stable percentage points, out-of-rowspace Frobenius norm percentages and squared-energy percentages match the inspected R1b SUMMARY numerical values exactly; max absolute difference 0.

The main route no longer turns residual net risk into a causal percentage. It correctly separates a stable-estimator negative result from unresolved direction, amplitude, source, density, structure and state mechanisms.

D=P_CAL D and X_DEV,perp D=0 are valid for the stated exact isotropically regularized mathematical solution. The wording correctly avoids carrying the exact identity over to arbitrary BF16 quantized matrices and does not use full rank or omega as proof of coverage.

P32/Q32, matched linear32+tanh32 readouts, b=0, scale-only CAL transforms, zero displacement and reversal properties are stated. L64/Q32 is now required whenever N>L32 motivates promotion, including when N also beats delta-N.

V3 uses same-method paired absolute MSE rather than ratios to changing Q1 baselines. V4 uses the fixed within-configuration relative estimator. BW/BWS use common-unit same-W-Q1-subtracted risk and preserve raw cell risks.

Same U/expert/endpoints/G_ref with both W1/W2 and biases, matched CAL11x512 fitting per W, and a mu_D-conditional claim are coherent. It does not require an A-line winner and is not called zero computation.

The predeclared CAL3/DEV3 subset reuses selected inputs. Per W, each matched task fits once on CAL3 x (D256+O256)=1536 paired observations, then holds parameters fixed across both mu values. It does not splice CAL11 BW fits. Shared noise/THW/expert/endpoint support and a common D gate are required; absent support yields UNIDENTIFIED.

Native CFG is part of mu_O, only the conditional branch is saved, and three DEV sources support a mechanism pilot only. The draft does not claim a total distillation, pure step-count or cross-architecture causal effect.

D4 bases 46 without CAL extension and 57 with extension are correct; optional full Dense timing totals 66/67/68 according to two/one/zero reusable neutral timings. O40 is separately bounded at six trajectories, 240 scheduler steps, conditionally 480 branch equivalents; 120 D4 equivalents are explicitly not wall time.

D4 pure U/Y is 1.5625 GiB per trajectory, 34.375 GiB for 22 and 51.5625 GiB for 33. Conditional O40 capture at three active layers per step is 120 calls per trajectory, 1.171875 GiB per trajectory and 7.03125 GiB for six.
selected_records and reserved_pool are object-for-object identical to the previously inspected v4 cohort; no new source quota or automatic experimental grid is introduced.

Same-input fit, actual typed full-site writeback and free-trajectory video are kept distinct. Candidate own-state banks, native targets and suffix restore packages are not falsely inferred from no-observer videos or the 512-row bank.
